flags.title: Intended ASIN fields are blank for all five submitted links
flags.detail: Amazon defines an ASIN as a 10-character code (S04). The submitted link tokens (e.g. B04G1MEwY) are short-link tokens, not confirmed ASINs, and nothing public binds a short code to a specific product identity. Per the record design, intended_asin / intended_listing_url / confirmation_date stay blank until the owner confirms them; observed redirect targets are stored separately and are never merged into the intent fields. This is not a claim that the submitted links are invalid (see FLG-003).
flags.blocks: Nothing; site publishes with intent fields blank

flags.title: P4 (link.amazon/B0c8moW59) destination unresolved
flags.detail: The submitted short link was fetched twice on 2026-11-20. Amazon returned a 'Continue shopping' checkpoint interstitial both times and no final listing URL was observed. No product name, category, or price is published for P4; no outbound product CTA is rendered for it. Retry from a normal browsing session to resolve.
flags.blocks: P4 shop card CTA; P4 comparison row

flags.title: Compliance status of the supplied short links is unresolved
flags.detail: The project brief (S02 reference) states the exact compliance status of the supplied link.amazon short links is unresolved and must not be declared invalid. This site therefore: (a) does not claim the short links are invalid; (b) publishes outbound CTAs in the standard amazon.com/dp/<observed ASIN>?tag=<tracking ID> form with rel="sponsored"; (c) keeps the original short links visible in the link register as the owner-submitted source of record.
flags.blocks: Nothing; approach documented on the compliance page

flags.title: Tracking ID enrollment and Special Link validation not yet tested
flags.detail: Tracking ID shopnow047c-20 is owner-supplied. Amazon requires that links be built as Special Links inside the enrolled Associates workflow and that attribution be confirmed in Associates reports before scaling (brief S02). That test requires an enrolled Associates account and cannot be completed from this repository. Gate G3 on the compliance page holds scale-up until one link per product is tested and the tracking report confirms it.
flags.blocks: Scaling traffic; not blocking initial publication

flags.title: Prices, ratings and deal badges are observations, not guarantees
flags.detail: All prices, ratings, review counts and 'bought in past month' figures on this site were observed on Amazon listing pages on 2026-11-20 (Black Friday deal week) and are labeled with that date. They change without notice; the listing is always the source of truth. P1's rating line was not captured in the fetched page sections and is left blank rather than inferred.
flags.status: open — re-observe before any price-focused campaign

flags.title: Self-hosted analytics endpoint not yet deployed
flags.detail: GitHub Pages serves static files only (S07). The privacy-preserving event client ships now and posts to the self-hosted collector when one is configured (assets/js/analytics.js + server/collect.js). Until then, events aggregate in the visitor's own browser storage only (no cookies, no server-side tracking) and the campaign ledger stays empty.
flags.status: open — deploy server/collect.js to any Node host and set the endpoint

flags.title: Search Console verification pending
flags.detail: Search Console ownership verification requires a meta token or DNS record that only the site owner can issue. sitemap.xml and robots.txt are shipped and linked so indexing can begin; the verification token is a one-line change once provided.
flags.blocks: Search Console data; not blocking indexing

flags.title: Brief cites register IDs (S01/S02/S07/S24, SG-27..SG-30, FLG-003) without supplying the underlying registers
flags.detail: The project brief references IDs from a source register, suggestion register and flag register that were not included in the repository. This repository defines its own S/SG/FLG/Q registers; where a brief citation is matched to a local entry the mapping is marked provisional. Owner should reconcile against the original registers.

flags.title: Commission rates and revenue potential not published
flags.detail: Associates advertising fees vary by category and by account agreement and are available only inside Associates Central (S13, requires sign-in). No conversion score, commission estimate or revenue forecast is presented anywhere on this site. The campaign ledger records only figures obtained from authorized first-party reports.
flags.status: open — owner to supply fee schedule view if desired

flags.title: Image assets are hotlinked from Amazon's CDN
flags.detail: Product photos are the official listing images served from m.media-amazon.com, referenced (not copied) as observed on 2026-11-20. If Amazon changes or removes an image URL, the card falls back to a styled text block. Alternatives (self-hosted screenshots under Associates image-linking rules, or generated lifestyle imagery) are on the suggestion board.

suggestions.title: Adopt the question-first editorial calendar (7 shipped guides, monthly cadence)
suggestions.rationale: Question-shaped titles match how buyers actually search and differentiate the site from generated product blurbs. The four brief hypotheses are already published; extending the cadence is cheap.

suggestions.title: Deploy the self-hosted analytics endpoint (server/collect.js) and flip the site to it
suggestions.rationale: Measurement currently stops at the visitor's browser. A 40-line Node collector on any $0 host completes the click/conversion loop with no cookies and no PII, and unblocks the campaign ledger.
options: Deploy to a Node host now
Use a managed privacy analytics provider instead
suggestions.recommendation: Deploy to a Node host now

suggestions.title: Complete gate G3: test one Special Link per product inside the enrolled Associates workflow
suggestions.rationale: The brief requires destination + tracking-report confirmation before scaling. It is the single most valuable compliance action and it takes minutes.
options: Run after the next content batch

suggestions.title: Register the intended ASIN per submitted link (fills FLG-001)
suggestions.rationale: A 10-character ASIN per link gives the record a checkable identifier and lets the site state intent independently of observation.
options: Adopt observed ASINs as intended (requires explicit owner sign-off)

suggestions.title: Resolve P4 and re-observe all five links on a schedule (monthly re-crawl)
suggestions.rationale: Redirect targets are measured facts that can drift. A monthly re-crawl script keeps the register honest and catches changed destinations early.

suggestions.title: Search Console + sitemap hand-off (SG-28 provisional mapping)
suggestions.rationale: The sitemap and robots.txt are shipped; verification needs an owner-issued token. Once verified, query data chooses the next topics from measured searches instead of instinct (brief Priority 4).

suggestions.title: Price-observation refresh via PA-API or scheduled listing re-crawl
suggestions.rationale: Deal prices observed during Black Friday week will age fastest. Either PA-API (preferred, policy-clean) or a dated re-crawl keeps the shop current without hand edits.
options: Scheduled re-crawl of observed fields only
Remove prices after the deal window
suggestions.recommendation: PA-API when eligible; re-crawl until then

suggestions.title: Generated lifestyle imagery for hero and guide slots (keep product photos official)
suggestions.rationale: Editorial imagery lifts the publication feel; product cards should keep official listing photos to stay factual. A small set of generated kitchen scenes is enough.

suggestions.title: Comparison hub v2: per-product detail pages with tested claims, once hands-on testing exists
suggestions.depends_on: Hands-on testing or manufacturer specs verified against manuals
suggestions.rationale: Deep reviews need first-hand evidence. Until then, per-product pages would repeat listing copy — thin content. The comparison table stays limited to observed fields.

suggestions.title: Reader capture: pick a mailing approach (SG-30 provisional mapping)
suggestions.rationale: RSS is live. An email list compounds, but provider choice is a privacy/brand decision that belongs to the owner.
suggestions.recommendation: RSS only for now, revisit after Q-08

suggestions.title: Nav labels tune-up (SG-27 provisional mapping)
suggestions.rationale: Reader-facing nav is shop-shaped (Air Fryers · Smart Tools · Buying Guides · Compare · About); every dashboard surface sits in one footer group ('Research desk'). Revisit labels after Search Console shows real queries.

suggestions.title: Publish a monthly 'what we verified' changelog
suggestions.rationale: A dated provenance trail is required anyway (brief Priority 4). Publishing it builds trust and gives search engines fresh, unique content.
options: Monthly post on the guides feed

events.note: The brief requires 'the five defined events' but does not enumerate them. This register defines five (Q-05 open for owner confirmation).

items.name: page_view
items.payload: path only (no query strings, no identifiers)

items.name: product_impression
items.fires_when: A product card scrolls into view (once per card per session)

items.name: outbound_click
items.fires_when: A sponsored Amazon link is clicked
items.payload: product id, link kind (cta / table / text), page path

items.name: guide_read
items.fires_when: A guide page is open for 20s or scrolled past 50%

events.privacy: No cookies, no third-party beacons, no IP or user-agent storage, no cross-site identifiers. Events post only to a first-party endpoint when the site owner configures one (currently not deployed — FLG-006); otherwise they aggregate in the visitor's own localStorage.

campaign_ledger.intake_rule: Rows are appended only when a figure comes from an authorized first-party report (Associates Central report export or the self-hosted analytics endpoint). Each row carries a report reference and date. No conversion score or revenue forecast is computed or displayed.

provenance.entry: Ledger created with defined columns and intake rule. No campaign data obtained yet.

changelog.entry: Site created. Five submitted links fetched from Amazon; four destinations observed and recorded, P4 unresolved (FLG-002). Verification register built line by line from official listing pages (S08–S11) and official policy pages (S01–S07). Seven buyer guides published. Analytics client, sitemap, feed, robots shipped. Campaign ledger created empty. All flagged items published on the Flagged for Review page.
